name: Melons Death Mod
description: Joke mod: on a new best there's a chance a sound plays, and when it ends, you die.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch for the whole mod.

chance-mode.name: Chance Mode
chance-mode.description:
<cy>Custom %</c>: uses the 'Chance' setting.
<cy>Randomized %</c>: every new best rolls a random chance between the min and max below.

chance.name: Chance (%)
chance.description: Chance that a new best triggers the audio (Custom % mode).

random-min.name: Randomized: Min (%)
random-min.description: Lowest chance that can be rolled in Randomized % mode.

random-max.name: Randomized: Max (%)
random-max.description: Highest chance that can be rolled in Randomized % mode.

freeze.name: Freeze Until Audio Ends
freeze.description: Freezes the icon (the whole level) while the audio plays. If off, you keep playing and can still die early.

kill-on-end.name: Kill When Audio Ends
kill-on-end.description: Kills you the moment the audio finishes.

min-percent.name: Minimum Best (%)
min-percent.description: The new best must be at least this percent to be able to trigger.

cooldown.name: Cooldown (attempts)
cooldown.description: Attempts that must pass after a trigger before it can trigger again. 0 = no cooldown.

practice.name: Work In Practice Mode
practice.description: Triggers on new practice-mode bests too.

custom-audio.name: Custom Audio
custom-audio.description: Pick your own mp3/ogg/wav. Leave empty to use the built-in sound.

volume.name: Volume (%)
volume.description: Volume of the audio. Above 100 amplifies it (careful!).

start-offset.name: Audio Start (sec)
start-offset.description: Start playing from this point in the audio. Works on custom audio too.

end-offset.name: Audio End (sec)
end-offset.description: Stop (and kill) at this point in the audio. 0 = play to the end of the file.

pause-music.name: Pause Level Music
pause-music.description: Pauses the level music while the audio plays.

flash.name: Screen Flash
flash.description: Flashes the screen when it triggers.

notify.name: Show Trigger Message
notify.description: Shows a small text on screen when it triggers (handy for testing).
